python_boundary_descriptions.arbitrary_extra_attribute: Python reflects arbitrary kwargs; C++ stores only documented fixed fields.
python_boundary_descriptions.duplicate_checking_level_call_binding: A flat checking_level is re-forwarded by Python as a duplicate kwarg; C++ validates and stores the checking enum directly.
python_boundary_descriptions.duplicate_restriction_call_binding: Flat restriction plus constraint_restrictions reaches Python as duplicate restriction kwargs and raises TypeError; C++ resolves precedence once.
python_boundary_descriptions.dynamic_key_stringified_once: Python stringifies an arbitrary dynamic key once; C++ accepts fixed setting keys.
python_boundary_descriptions.integer_generative_coercion: Python retains integer 1; the typed C++ setting boundary requires bool.
python_boundary_descriptions.nested_python_config: Python expands a dynamic nested config; repository settings use flat fields.
python_boundary_descriptions.non_string_name: Python retains a non-string name; the typed C++ registry owns strings.
